rule_summary: Deportation or transfer of protected persons from occupied territory may constitute a grave breach or war crime.
Unlawful confinement of protected persons may constitute a grave breach or war crime.
Transfer by an occupying power of parts of its own civilian population into occupied territory is prohibited and criminalized in the Rome Statute.
key_authorities: Geneva Convention IV Article 49; Rome Statute

rule_summary: Sentencing without indispensable judicial guarantees may constitute a war crime.
